propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit repository discovery via cwd or git -C without explicit --git-dir

Git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD operations reject bare repositories under explicit safe policy when invoked through generic worktree-oriented helpers that do not specify repository kind

The restore.git throwaway repository in infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore fails at fetch and rev-parse invocations that route through generic git -C helpers incompatible with explicit safe policy

Explicit --git-dir targeting restores bare-repository command success under strict safe.bareRepository=explicit while preserving worktree helper behavior and all upkeep pins, refs, and error semantics
Test fixtures and scripts must explicitly identify owned bare repositories at call sites rather than relying on implicit discovery through cwd routing or generic helpers
